description.value: China Creek Regional Park is a nature reserve managed by the Alberni-Clayoquot Regional District, located south of Port Alberni on Vancouver Island. The park sits along the Alberni Inlet, offering a natural stopover for cyclists touring the Highway 4 corridor between Port Alberni and the west coast.
